proposals.evidence: The entire predicate is hunger + be felt/strike. Turner bubhukṣā explicitly documents regional bhukh/bhok and related hunger nouns, while lagyati supplies lāg-/lag- with the relevant felt/begin meanings. Local vowel/aspiration variation and ordinary finite endings are retained; each of the two lexical constituents is linked in spoken order.

proposals.evidence: The full response has thirst + be felt: pipāsā through piās/pyās, plus lagyati through lag-/lāg-. Turner specifically attests piās in the eastern Hindi languages and piyās in Nepali. Both constituents and the local past/future endings are retained; other auxiliaries are not silently discarded.
